HAZARA FOREST (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Hazara ForestAct, 1936
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP.Legis/91/5141, dated
26-3-1991.--The Hazara Forest (Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 12th March, 1991
and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 21st
March, 1991, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West
Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Hazara Forest (Amendment) Act,1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 12 of N.W.F.P. Act No.VI of 1937

ACT VI OF 1991
ACT VI OF 1991
HAZARA FOREST (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Hazara ForestAct, 1936
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP.Legis/91/5141, dated
26-3-1991.--The Hazara Forest (Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 12th March, 1991
and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 21st
March, 1991, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West
Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 12 of N: W.F.P. Act No.VI of 1937.--In the
Hazara Forest Act, 1936 (N.-W.F.P Act No.VI of 1937), in section 12, for
subsection (1), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(1) Subject to the rights
and powers of the Government in respect of seigniorage and forest conservancy
as defined in the Act or in rules made thereunder, and subject also to the
claims of right-holders not being owners of the soil, as the case may be, all
waste-land or the property, held jointly or severally, as the case may be, of
the land-owners of the village in whose boundaries these are included. Such
land-owners are entitled to use, free of charge, for their own domestic and
agricultural requirements any trees and forest produce found on these
waste-lands, but they shall have no right or power to sell any trees or
bush-wood growing in such lands, except with the permission of the Deputy
Commissioner or other officer authorised by the Provincial Government and under
such conditions as the Deputy Commissioner may impose. All such sales shall be
subject to payment to the Provincial Government of seigniorage fees as provided
by section 27. The land-owners may also utilize the timber for construction of
their own commercial buildings and grant the timber in gift for special
purposes on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed by rules."
